mlp_full.notes: MLP+ReLU, 'full' features, mean of 3 seeds; fit on fit agents, early-stopped on stop agents

gat_daily.notes: GATDaily (gatv2_sigmoid, d=32, 4 heads, daily steps); whole run in graph, survival loss on fit agents; checkpoint chosen by stop-agent logloss (not val)

meanfield_js.notes: model/meanfield.js (Baker MF), default params (lambdaScale 0.901), phone inputs incl. reports; p = 1 - P_S at end of run (includes the 2% prior infected mass at t=0). Uncalibrated for this run: expected infections 2959/7500 (39%) vs ~5% observed

meanfield_js[p_final].notes: meanfield_js scored with p_final instead (reference only)

meanfield_js[p_max].notes: meanfield_js scored with p_max instead (reference only)

meanfield_js_raw+isotonic.notes: reference: raw meanfield_js p_ever mapped by isotonic regression fitted on train agents (fit+stop)

meanfield_js_calibrated.notes: model/meanfield.js with prior = n_seeds/N = 5/7500 and lambdaScale refitted as meanfield-cli --calibrate (true seeds, no reports, prior 0, no imports) to train-agent non-import infections scaled to all non-seeds (no val leakage); final pass with reports; p = 1 - P_S at end. fitted lambdaScale 1.12828 (bracket [1.12768, 1.12889], 10 iterations); final pass (reports, prior 0.0006666666666666666, lambdaScale 1.12828): 1255 s, expected infections 1710.6

meanfield_js_fit_reports.notes: model/meanfield.js with prior = 5/7500 and lambdaScale fitted on the full scored model (reports included) so mean P(ever infected) over train agents = their attack rate (ml/scripts/kl_mf_fit.mjs); p = 1 - P_S at end. fitted lambdaScale 0.56934: mean P(train) 0.0550 vs target 0.0540 after 4 passes

const_val_rate.notes: constant p = val attack rate; cheats on prevalence (per-agent KL = entropy H(ybar), aggregate KL = 0)
